pick.name: Chatwoot
pick.what: Open-source omnichannel support inbox (chat, email, WhatsApp, etc.)
pick.why: MIT core, self-hostable with no seat limits, API + agent bots so Claude can answer first-line; cloud free tier to start
pick.free_limits: Cloud Hacker: 2 agents, 500 conversations/mo, live chat only, 30-day retention; self-host CE free
pick.windows_fit: wsl/web (self-host via Docker on Linux VM)
pick.install: web, or docker compose (Chatwoot self-host guide)

alts.name: tawk.to
alts.what: Free live chat + ticketing + knowledge base
alts.why: Most generous hosted free tier (free for life with branding)
alts.free_limits: Core free; remove branding USD 29/mo; AI Assist from USD 29/mo

alts.name: Crisp
alts.why: Best UX if you'll pay later (Mini USD 45/mo, 4 seats)
alts.free_limits: Free: 2 seats, 100 customer profiles, no AI, watermark

candidates.name: Chatwoot
candidates.verdict: PICK: OSS, API-first, cloud free then self-host

candidates.name: tawk.to
candidates.verdict: Pick if you never want to host anything

decision: Start on Chatwoot Cloud's free tier. When volume passes 500 conversations/month or you want email/WhatsApp channels, self-host the MIT edition on a small always-free VM and wire a Claude-powered agent bot. tawk.to is the zero-ops fallback.

verify.note: Cloud Hacker plan confirmed: 2 agents, 500 conv/mo, live chat only, 30-day retention. LICENSE is MIT outside enterprise/ (GitHub reports NOASSERTION because of the split). v4.19.1 on 2026-10-24. tawk.to alt confirmed (USD 29 branding removal, AI Assist from USD 29). Crisp alt confirmed (2 seats, 100 profiles, no AI; Mini USD 45).
